sections.Profile:
"San Francisco" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in May 1964. Designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features a vibrant San Francisco theme, capturing the essence of the city's landmarks and culture. The playfield includes two flippers, three jet bumpers, six passive bumpers, two slingshots, six rollover buttons, two standup targets, two kick-out holes, a gobble hole, and a rollunder.
